body:
STEP 1 (helper-p335, 15 Nov 2026, main 57941c5): WHERE THE 47 MINUTES COME FROM. Code read only; numbers are the audit's (evidence/README.md B-60) unless said.

SERVER, in order of size:
1. THE HOURLY TICK (the 47 min). config.py:73,106 ENCORE_SCAN_EVERY_MIN=60 -> api.py:1726 every_s=3600 -> scanner.py:216 `wait = self._every` counted from the END of the previous pass. Nothing is tied to the music server's scan, and `poke()` (scanner.py:192) has no caller. So the delay is a coin toss between 0 and 60 min (mean 30): scan ended 03:01, ticks at 02:47, 03:48:25, 04:51 (passes of 1.4 and 2.6 min move the phase). 47 min is where the tick fell, not a constant.
2. THE ERRANDS RUN FIRST. scanner.py:177 runs `before` (api.py errands(): heal_libraries, cover finder up to 300 look-ups at 0.25 s, artist finder up to 20 at 1 s plus a wait for a scan of up to 60 s, tombstone purge, ref janitor) before every pass: up to about 2 to 3 min on top of the tick (the second gap above: 62.6 min = 60 + 2.6). The cover and artist finders call start_scan after a find (api.py:1701,1703): the cover finder's own scan is why a pass can meet "scanning".
3. THE MUSIC SERVER'S OWN DISCOVERY (not closed by any fix of ours): deploy/compose.yaml:15 ND_SCANSCHEDULE "@every 1h" plus its file watcher. The audit asked for a full scan by hand, so it never measured the watcher. A watcher does not see files on network shares or some Docker Desktop mounts: there the schedule (up to 60 min) is the real delay. Unmeasured.

PHONE (app open), and a correction of the item text:
4. THE PROBE DOES NOT CARRY THE FILES FEED. sync_engine.dart:679 the probe calls `encore.pullChanges()` = the person's changes feed (likes, playlists, entries), NOT the files feed. The files feed (new library songs) is pulled only by a full run (sync_engine.dart:469 `encore.pull()`): every 10 min while the app is open (sync_scheduler.dart:60 foregroundInterval), on resume after 5 min (:61), on manual sync, or when the probe says the browse index is due. A server push (hello, library.changed, resync) only makes a probe now (session.dart:540 -> scheduler.liveEvent), so it would not bring files either. Worst case after the link: 10 min.
5. THE BROWSE INDEX (artists, albums) waits for `libraryPassGap` 1 h, 6 h on mobile data (sync_engine.dart:59-60, check at :632-646), counted from the last full pass, and only when the music server's scan status moved. On an Encore server that pass fetches artists and album pages only (`songs: false`, :445-ish), not the song dump the 1 h was priced for (8.6 MB).

Total for a phone with the app open, as built: 0 to 60 min (tick) + about 3 min (errands) + up to 10 min (files feed) and the albums/artists lists up to 1 h more (6 h on mobile data). Cost of a pass on the Encore side (this PC, in-process, fake music server): 0.09 ms per song when nothing changed (7,200 songs: 0.7 s), 0.46 ms per song when all are new (7,200: 3.3 s). The music server's side (400 search3 pages of 500 for 200,000 songs) is NOT measured.
